title: Tabletop banner bearer in six steps
summary: A fast tabletop scheme for the banner-carrying trooper that comes in the Strike Force box.

target.description: The banner carrier from the Vanguard Strike Force box - 32mm plastic, one piece, banner moulded to the arm

steps.title: Block in
steps.instruction: Spray the model Field Blue and leave it to cure fully.

steps.title: Banner
steps.instruction: Brush the banner field Warm Ivory over two coats; ignore the weave.

steps.title: One pass drybrush
steps.instruction: Drybrush the whole model with Warm Ivory, hard enough to catch the armour edges only.

org.brushcodex.subject:identity.qualifier: the one-piece banner body, not the Mk2 with the separate pole

org.brushcodex.product:sourceContext.note: A different box and a different SKU from the blister. The subject identity does not move.
